shortDescription: Rajasthan RVUNL Junior Engineer & Other Posts Online Form 2026 for ~2005 vacancies. Apply 05–25 August 2026 for JE, Junior Accountant & Junior Assistant.
content:
Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited (RVUNL) has announced common recruitment for power sector posts including Junior Engineer, Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant / Commercial Assistant-II.

Total posts: ~2005. Online applications: 05 August 2026 to 25 August 2026.

Vacancy snapshot

  • Junior Engineer JEN-I (Electrical) – 727
  • Junior Engineer JEN-I (Mechanical) – 110
  • Junior Engineer JEN-I (Civil) – 32
  • Junior Accountant – 371
  • Junior Assistant / Commercial Assistant-II – 765

Apply through the Energy Department / RRVUN recruitment portal. Read post-wise eligibility carefully before submission.
